punchline: He did not stretch his memory; he found hooks for it.
thirty_sec: At Carnegie Mellon, undergraduate Steve Faloon, an ordinary student, raised his digit span from 7 to 79 over more than 230 hours by reading digit groups as running times and building an order for them.
question: Which list do you keep losing that you could attach to something you already know well?
key_contrast: Capacity stayed ordinary; the way of storing changed.
